title: Bus model input
description: The input to the bus renderer: dimensions per body section, tyres, colour, front text and optional door/window hints. Everything in it is drawn; dimension names follow NeTEx VehicleType (Width, Height) in snake_case with explicit mm units.
$comment: Rules JSON Schema cannot express, checked in code: (1) each section's axles_mm ascending and inside 0..length_mm; (4) axle_gap < number of axles - 1; (5) placed doors (doors or doors_hint) must not overlap each other or an arch, nor reach past the section's end. Regulation rules (2) total length and (3) door count moved to src/limits.js.

roof_equipment_mm.description: Height of roof pods (batteries, HVAC) included in height_mm. The body box is drawn to height_mm minus this, with a roof pod on top.

band_above_mm.description: Band of body between the top of the doors and side windows and the top of the body (height_mm minus roof_equipment_mm). Doors and side windows are drawn up to this line.

win_band_height_mm.description: Height of the side window band, measured down from the line band_above_mm gives. Side windows are this high, stopping at the skirt on a body too low for it.

band_below_grill_mm.description: Band of body below the grille and the headlights, down to the lower edge of the flat front, where the rounding to the skirt starts. The badge that stands in for the grille and the headlights stand on this line.

band_below_windshield_mm.description: Band of body below the windshield, down to the lower edge of the flat front, like band_below_grill_mm. When missing: the windshield ends 200 mm below the lower edge of the side windows, that is band_above_mm + win_band_height_mm + 200 below the top of the body. The windshield is drawn down to this line, stopping above the grille.

front_display.description: Text on the destination display, e.g. a line number and destination. A dark display at the top of the windshield showing this text, set smaller when it is long. Empty or missing: no display.

tyre.description: Give a size string, a diameter, or both. Code derives the diameter from the size if needed.

badge_text.description: Text in place of the grille. Missing: none.

sections.description: Body sections front to rear. One item for a rigid bus, two for articulated, three for bi-articulated.

axles_mm.description: Axle centres, measured from the front of this section. Wheelbase and overhangs are derived.

doors_hint.description: Door hints for this section. A section without the list has no doors. An empty list is the same.

doors.description: Doors at fixed places: each door's front edge x_mm from the front of this section, and its width. A section takes doors or doors_hint, not both.

bellows_ahead_mm.description: Length of the joint bellows between this section and the one in front.

door_hint.description: Where a door roughly is, relative to the section's axles. Used by the template fallback and checked against the VLM result.

axle_gap.description: For between_axles with 3 axles: 0 = first gap, 1 = second.

bias.description: Position inside the zone. rear in between_axles = just ahead of the rear arch.

leaves.description: 1 = single door (default width about 900 mm), 2 = double door (about 1250 mm).

width_mm.description: Overrides the width implied by leaves.

door_at.description: A door at a fixed place, in mm from the front of its section.

count.description: Side windows in this section on the entry side, door glass excluded. Omitted: the band is filled with panes of about the same width.

examples.$comment: Articulated city bus. Section lengths and axle positions are illustrative.
